name: Question 3
worked_solution:
To get the minor of of ${c}_{11}$, we remove the $1$st row and $1$st column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}3 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 7 & 0 & 1 \\ ∗ & 13 & 5 & 5 \\ ∗ & -9 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{11}=|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 1 \\ 13 & 5 & 5 \\ -9 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$
